steps.what: Supervise or train cardiology technologists or students and observe their clinical work

tasks.design: Retain direct supervision, teaching and observation with the technologist, using current guidance in {DOCS}. Check native document access if retrieval is separately burdensome; documentation automation does not establish a reduction in live supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching depends on learner actions, patient context and professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital references aid teaching without replacing observation.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a misunderstanding that requires immediate coaching.
tasks.human_edge: Adapting instruction to the learner while understanding the clinical situation.
tasks.altitude: Supervision and teaching responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a trainee's communication during patient care

evidence.claim: The supplied image and documentation tools do not establish replacement of live cardiology supervision or teaching.

assumptions: Boundary covers instructor supervision and teaching only; trainee work, patient care by others and formal competence decisions retain their own time.
Trainee actions and questions arise during s1; instructor interprets them there. No machine assumes a free competence or patient-readiness flag.
Native guidance access is checked before adding support software.
No new system or capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there a distinct repetitive preparation burden beyond direct teaching?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Supervision and trainee interactions retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify heart wall thickness and chamber measurements and select applicable standard norms
Compare numerical measurements with the selected reference ranges
Identify possible abnormalities using comparison results, source images and clinical judgement

tasks.design: Test native comparison functions in {OTHER}, the cardiac imaging workstation, against locally accepted reference data in {DOCS}. Automate numerical comparison only after the technologist checks inputs and selects the reference; interpretation and referral remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated numerical comparison can distract from image and context review.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed comparison functions can operate on checked measurements and explicit reference ranges.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement validity and reference applicability determine whether a difference has clinical meaning.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising artefact, inappropriate comparisons and uncertainty requiring specialist review.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic where still manual; clinical interpretation rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Configured numerical range comparison is plausible; the supplied lung, brain and EEG products do not demonstrate cardiac measurement interpretation or local savings.

assumptions: Boundary covers comparison of already acquired measurements and technologist interpretation; measurement acquisition, cardiologist diagnosis and care decisions retain separate labour.

Acquiring technologist produces source images and measurements in the existing acquisition task. Focal technologist in s1 verifies patient/study ID, image/frame reference, anatomical measurement label, value, units, acquisition context and selected reference/version, including any required indexing inputs; capture and suitability checking retain 35 hours.

Native function consumes the checked values and explicitly selected numeric ranges, whose source/version is confirmed in s1. Missing, unsupported or mismatched inputs return to manual comparison; no free abnormality or image-quality flag is assumed.
Native workstation configuration and local clinical validation precede custom code. Existing automatic comparison runtime earns no saving; additional reference support is counted below.
research_questions: Does native numerical comparison reduce remaining manual work after input verification and clinical interpretation?

already_counted.description: Input and reference capture, meaning checks and clinical interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain reference version checks and calculation examples
Clinical reference governance and workstation support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+40=75, gross=25, focal upkeep=8, net=17. Range 0-3 assumes repeated manual numerical comparisons; existing workstation automation or substantial reference uncertainty removes the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe displays and record vascular information

steps.what: Observe ultrasound display and listen to signals to record vascular information

tasks.design: Retain observation, signal interpretation and recording in {OTHER}, the ultrasound workstation. Test native capture functions if a separate duplicate-entry burden is measured; the task itself does not establish such a baseline.
tasks.previous_blocker: The information depends on signal quality, patient context and live observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Workstation recording supports the activity without replacing its interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing meaningful vascular information from artefact or incomplete acquisition.
tasks.human_edge: Integrating what is seen, heard and known about the study context.
tasks.altitude: Live observation and record interpretation remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: The supplied imaging and EEG examples do not establish replacement of this live vascular observation and recording task.

assumptions: Boundary covers technologist observation and contemporaneous recording, excluding later diagnostic review and separate report production.
Technologist obtains and interprets signals during s1; no machine assumes an already validated structured vascular finding or patient-device linkage.
OTHER is the ultrasound workstation. Native capture is checked first if duplicate entry is observed.
No new system or capture obligation means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Does recording contain repeated copying beyond live acquisition and interpretation?

already_counted.description: Live observation, signal interpretation and recording

incremental.description: No new upkeep or transferred work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, incremental=0, net=0. No duplicate recording baseline or outside clinician saving is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess cardiac physiology and calculate valve areas

steps.what: Verify blood flow velocity measurements and select the applicable valve area calculation method
Calculate valve areas using the selected method and checked measurements
Assess cardiac physiology and check valve area results against the source study

tasks.design: Use a locally validated native calculation in {OTHER}, the cardiac imaging workstation, after the technologist checks method applicability against guidance in {DOCS}. Keep physiological assessment and result interpretation fully counted; the calculation produces no autonomous clinical conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic can recur alongside method selection and physiological interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed workstation calculations can apply an explicitly selected method to checked inputs.
tasks.still_hard: The method's assumptions and measurement quality may not fit the case.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising implausible results and relating them to the underlying study.
tasks.altitude: Less manual arithmetic where present; physiology judgement remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: A selected validated method can support deterministic valve-area arithmetic, but the supplied digest does not establish this capability's local implementation or savings.

assumptions: Boundary starts with an acquired study and ends at technologist assessment; acquisition, cardiologist diagnosis and treatment decisions retain separate labour.

Acquiring technologist produces the source study in existing acquisition work. Focal technologist in s1 verifies patient/study ID, measurement labels, source frame or trace, values and units, selected method/version and every method-required additional input; capture and applicability checks retain 40 hours.

The configured calculation accepts only that method's complete checked field set. Missing or unreliable values return to manual study review and clarification; no free validated measurement or physiological suitability flag is assumed.
Test native workstation functions and local validation before custom code. Existing automatic arithmetic earns no new saving; additional clinical and technical support is counted below.
research_questions: How much manual arithmetic remains after native functions, capture, method checks and upkeep?

already_counted.description: Measurement capture, method selection and physiological result interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+40=80, gross=20, focal upkeep=8, net=12. Range 0-3 assumes recurring manual arithmetic; existing native calculations or extensive measurement uncertainty remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
